name: block-motion
description: The shared Framer Motion animation language for ibirdui blocks: signature spring presets, reveal / enter-exit variants, a namespaced shared-layout id helper, and a MotionProvider that makes every block honour prefers-reduced-motion automatically.

intents: add consistent, accessible Framer Motion animation to a block
stagger children into view on mount
animate enter and exit with AnimatePresence
share a layout animation between elements (morphing pill, reordering cards)
respect prefers-reduced-motion across a whole block
